title: A Wild Bird Leads Humans to Honey, but Only If You Call It

scenes.text: A wild bird answers when humans call it.
In Mozambique, honey hunters make a trilling grunt: brrr-hm.
Greater honeyguide birds hear it and lead them to hidden bee nests.
With the call, hunters were shown a nest 54 percent of the time. Without it, just 16.
The humans take the honey. The bird gets the leftover wax.
A wild bird that works for people, on command.

description:
A wild bird answers when humans call it.
In Mozambique, honey hunters use a special brrr-hm call, and greater honeyguide birds lead them to bee nests far more often.
Would you trust a bird to lead you to honey?
first_comment: Wild bird and human teamwork: have you ever heard a story like this?
